supporting_pages.title: Monitoring Config Connector with Prometheus \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: For example, If you are using the Prometheus Operator and configure it with ServiceMonitor , you can apply the following configuration to scrape metrics from Config Connector. spec : endpoints : - interval : 10s port : metrics namespaceSelector : matchNames : - cnrm-system selector : matchLabels : cnrm.cloud.google.com/monitored : "true" cnrm.cloud.google.com/system : "true" Example queries Prometheus uses a query language called PromQL .
Configuring Prometheus Before you can scrape metrics, you might need to configure Prometheus for Kubernetes Service Discovery (SD) to discover scrape targets from the Kubernetes REST API.
Monitoring Config Connector with Prometheus You can use Prometheus to collect and show metrics from Config Connector.
